from pathlib import Path
prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(flat), key=flat.count)
    row_cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    def segments(length, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if cut > start:
                out.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < length:
            out.append((start, length))
        return out
    rs = segments(h, row_cuts)
    cs = segments(w, col_cuts)
    counts = []
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rs):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(cs):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            counts.append((n, i, j))
    _, si, sj = max(counts)
    sr0, sr1 = rs[si]
    sc0, sc1 = cs[sj]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rs):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(cs):
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r][c] = grid[sr0 + (r-r0)][sc0 + (c-c0)]
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(prog)
print(p, p.exists())
